page_title: REI 0-0 NAN | Reims v Nantes 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Hugo Boutsingkham (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Florent Mollet.
90+1' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' A superb shot by Teddy Teuma (Reims) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
89' Teddy Teuma (Reims) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
87' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
87' Reims will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
87' 8:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
84' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Reda Khadra will be replaced by Adama Bojang (Reims).
84' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' Substitution. Tino Kadewere did his best and is replaced by Adel Mahamoud (Nantes).
81' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
79' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
78' Amadou Kone (Reims) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alban Lafont comes off the line to clear the ball away.
73' Penalty saved! Tino Kadewere (Nantes) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
73' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
72' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Therence Koudou (Reims) for his blatant foul.
72' It’s a PENALTY to Nantes after the VAR review!
71' Referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nantes. Let’s see what happens!
71' Therence Koudou (Reims) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul. Nantes are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
69' A crossfield pass from Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates.
68' Substitution. Therence Koudou (Reims) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Thomas Foket walks off.
68' Reda Khadra (Reims) will deliver the corner kick.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:6.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nantes.
64' Yehvann Diouf steps in and intercepts a long pass from Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
60' That's the end of the game for Josh Wilson-Esbrand (Reims), who is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marshall Munetsi (Reims) comes onto the pitch for Amine Salama.
59' Reda Khadra (Reims) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
59' Teddy Teuma (Reims) and Amine Salama combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
58' Florent Mollet (Nantes) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Yehvann Diouf.
58' The free kick will be taken by Florent Mollet (Nantes).
58' Thomas Foket (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
57' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' It's a throw-in for Nantes.
54' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' What a big chance! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
51' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
49' Florent Mollet (Nantes) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Yehvann Diouf.
48' The Nantes players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Jocelyn Gourvennec has made a change at the break. Kader Bamba has come on in place of Marcus Coco (Nantes).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Thibault De Smet (Reims) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Reims enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
39' Eray Comert (Nantes) is substituted due to injury. Jocelyn Gourvennec gives a chance to Nicolas Pallois.
34' Eray Comert (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Poor challenge! Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is penalised for tripping and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle.
33' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
32' A long pass, executed by Thibault De Smet (Reims), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
30' The ball is cleared after Amine Salama (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
28' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle after Mohamed Daramy (Reims) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
25' That's unlucky! Amadou Kone (Reims) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
23' Amine Salama (Reims) and Reda Khadra combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.

21' Amine Salama (Reims) wins himself some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a low shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
20' Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
19' The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
13' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
11' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
8' Teddy Teuma (Reims) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Alban Lafont.
7' One of the Nantes players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Reims earn a free kick.
6' Teddy Teuma (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.

5' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
5' Teddy Teuma (Reims) will take the free kick.
4' Eray Comert (Nantes) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
4' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' Marcus Coco (Nantes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yehvann Diouf, who smothers the ball.
2' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will supervise the game today.
